serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: VOS Sapphire is a cloud-based workforce development platform that helps government agencies modernize employment services. It combines labor exchange, case management, employer services, unemployment insurance integration, labor market information, reporting, and program management into one secure system. VOS Sapphire streamlines operations through automation, improves collaboration and compliance, and delivers personalized services for job seekers, employers, workforce professionals, educators, and partner organizations.
